name: "Ellas": Colombian App for Addressing Gender-based violence
content: Problems and Purpose Created in 2015, "They" (Span. Ellas) is an app and website that provides women in Colombia with information about different types of gender-based violence. A project by the National Women’s Network of Colombia, it aims at empowering victims of sexual, physical, economic or political violence with knowledge about what violence is about, and which authorities to reach out to. Background History and Context Organizing, Supporting, and Funding Entities Participant Recruitment and Selection Methods and Tools Used What Went On: Process, Interaction, and Participation The app contains a feedback option for women to inform the Red Nacional de Mujeres about the attention they received so that Red can later influence responsible entities to comply with their obligations to protect female victims of gender-based violence. In addition to the app, the project includes a website where women can access training on gender-based violence. Since 2020, the app includes a panic button to alert their chosen emergency contact, in addition to a geolocation tool containing the nearest emergency care facilities. More than 15.000 users have downloaded the up since its creation in 2020.
